verdict.rationale: The API/SDK flow is documented as fully backend-drivable — creating applicants and workflow runs from a server with API/OAuth tokens, retrieving results via webhook or polling, with no UI required (docs-3, docs-6, docs-14, docs-15, docs-4). This supports headless/automated integration, but there is no explicit mention of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, or command-line/headless SDK usage patterns, and Workflow Studio is positioned as a no-code drag-and-drop tool rather than a CI-automatable config path. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless test-automation guidance, and confirmation that Workflow Studio configuration itself can be automated/scripted rather than only via the GUI.
